data.description: Phase A2 of the front-end design plan (docs/design/00-frontend-design-plan.md, board msg 283). GATED on BRANDING.md existing at repo root (Phase A1, non-Lattice, authored by designer-sofia — do not start this task before A1 ships). Deliverables: framework-neutral tokens.css (CSS custom properties) + tokens.json expressing every BRANDING.md decision (colors with contrast ratios, type scale, spacing), plus a static no-build HTML style-reference page under docs/design/style-reference/ rendering every token and primitive (button, input, table, card) in default/hover/disabled/error states. This file pair becomes the single source of visual truth for everything shipped after. Acceptance: handoff contract in plan doc section 5 — no magic values, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast recorded, semantic HTML, renders at 375px. Zero spend: open-license assets only; any license need is a board ask, not a purchase. Decision context: board directed front-end design work in #board msg 283; company brand is deliberately product-agnostic so this work is valid regardless of the step-5 outcome.
data.title: Design tokens + static style reference derived from BRANDING.md

data.body:
GATE LIFTED: BRANDING.md now exists at repo root (commit 0a50315, authored agent:designer-sofia). This task's dependency — plan A1, docs/design/00-frontend-design-plan.md §4 — is satisfied, so AS-29 is pullable.

Independently verified by the orchestrator before unblocking, because AS-29 encodes these numbers as tokens.css/tokens.json truth and a wrong ratio here propagates silently: all 44 contrast pairs in §3.4 were re-derived from the semantic token hex values using WCAG 2.1 relative luminance. 44/44 reproduce the documented ratio exactly, 0 below their stated threshold. Two dark-mode pairs (accent-solid, danger-solid button fills) failed Sofia's own first pass at 2.54:1 and 2.60:1 against the near-black canvas; she moved each to a lighter step in the same hue scale and recorded the correction in §3.4 rather than hiding it.

What AS-29 consumes: §3.1 primitives (ink/accent/success/warning/danger scales, hex-defined), §3.2 and §3.3 semantic aliases resolved per mode (28 tokens each, light and dark), §4.2 type scale, §6.1 spacing scale, §6.2 radius, §6.3 elevation, §6.4 breakpoints, and §6.5 which sketches a token implementation pattern. Typefaces are Inter and JetBrains Mono, both SIL OFL 1.1 with license lines recorded and verified against source.

STILL OPEN before BRANDING.md is 'adopted' per plan §4 A1: CEO and CTO both read it. Sofia announced it in #announcements (msgs 315, 316); their next inbox sweep surfaces it. That read is an acceptance step for A1, not a blocker on starting AS-29.

CTO acceptance read of BRANDING.md: ADOPTED (plan §4 A1 gate, docs/design/00-frontend-design-plan.md). Countersigned 2026-08-31; posted in full to #announcements msg 318 where Sofia announced it. Independently re-derived §3.4 with the §11 formula — all documented ratios reproduce exactly. Six findings, none blocking, all absorbed into this plan so the implementer never guesses: (F1) §4.1 'self-host fonts in-repo' contradicts §7.D.14 'no binary assets in this repository' — resolved for AS-29 as NO font binaries, fallback stacks only, no network at render time; Sofia may overrule in v1.1. (F2) §3.4 verifies foregrounds almost entirely against bg-canvas, but components sit on bg-surface/bg-surface-sunken — five dark-mode pairs fail, incl. danger-solid on bg-surface at 2.97:1 (3:1 floor), a destructive button on a card. Proved the feasible-luminance window: NON-EMPTY on bg-surface (one new danger step ~#D62937 fixes it), EMPTY on bg-surface-sunken (no colour can satisfy a 4.5:1 white label AND a 3:1 boundary — structural fix required). border-interactive/ink-500 is the one token clearing 3:1 on all three dark backgrounds (4.82/4.15/3.28) and is the structural fix. (F3) dark border-hairline is byte-identical to dark bg-surface-sunken (1.00:1) — a hairline there is absent, not subtle. (F4) no hover/active semantics outside solid fills. (F5) focus-ring geometry and border-width undefined — three allowlisted AS-29 additions. (F6) no icon set + emoji banned, so states are text+colour+shape. Palette amendments are Sofia's v1.1 call and are NOT prerequisites for this task.

Plan written and moving to planned. Approach: this task adds ZERO visual judgment — its value is fidelity and verifiability. Key decisions baked in so Sofia doesn't have to make them mid-implementation: (1) File layout — docs/design/tokens/{tokens.css,tokens.json,tokens.test.mjs} + docs/design/style-reference/{index.html,reference.css}. Tokens get their own dir because the style reference is a CONSUMER, not the owner; a future front-end app links tokens.css without reaching through a docs page. No package.json (.mjs is ESM without one; a manifest would imply a dependency surface). (2) Light/dark — four ordered blocks: primitives; light on ':root, [data-theme="light"]'; dark under '@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme="light"])'; explicit '[data-theme="dark"]'. Two deliberate deltas from BRANDING §6.5: attribute selectors (not :root-only) so a nested div re-scopes the semantic layer — that is what lets the page show light AND dark side by side without touching OS settings — and color-scheme set alongside so native inputs/scrollbars follow. Blocks 3+4 duplicate 28 aliases; CSS cannot avoid that without a build step, so the test asserts they are identical. Do NOT 'DRY' it with a preprocessor. (3) tokens.json consumer contract — the parity test is the PRESENT-TENSE consumer; if the test stops reading it, delete the file. Flat, versioned, non-DTCG (considered and rejected: buys compatibility with build pipelines we have none of and have banned; revisit trigger = first real ingesting tool). Semantic tokens record BOTH resolved value and alias name — the alias is what catches 'alias says ink-700, value is ink-600'. (4) Mechanical parity — tokens.test.mjs parses BRANDING.md's own tables and compares them to both artifacts: three-way equality, completeness in BOTH directions, pinned counts (catches a row deleted from both sides), alias integrity, dark-block duplication invariant, contrast recomputation from hexes to 2dp, magic-value scan (zero raw hex outside the primitive block), mobile-first scan, and a loud failure if a table cannot be parsed. Additions are gated by an allowlist in the test file, so a fourth token requires editing a test with a reason. Consequence: BRANDING.md §3-§6 table format becomes a machine contract, same precedent as the personnel frontmatter subset in CLAUDE.md. Run with: node --test 'docs/design/tokens/*.test.mjs' — Node 22+ takes a GLOB, not a directory (verified on v24.13.1 here; node --test <dir> fails with 'Could not find').
